title: PEPSI Co - Conducts Recruitment Drive at AWKUM
text:
The
PEPSI Co recruitment team, led by Mr. Abdul Mateen Fazal – MTO HR, along with
Mr. Fahad Tahir – Assistant Manager HR, Mr. Safiullah – Quality Control
Manager, and Mr. Babar Qamar – Sales Manager, conducted an on-campus
recruitment drive at Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan (AWKUM) on June 17,
2025. The activity was organized to fill positions for Trainee Food Chemist and
Management Trainee Officer (MTO) Sales.

During
the recruitment process, 38 students were interviewed, and out of 13
shortlisted candidates, 4 Management Trainee Officers (MTOs) and 1 Trainee Food
Chemist were selected for permanent positions. The HR team also provided
valuable feedback to the participating students, offering guidance on how to
improve their presentation and interview skills for future opportunities.

Mr.
Abdul Mateen Fazal and his team also held discussions with the Director of the
Career Development Centre (CDC) regarding future prospects, collaborations, and
continued engagement for student career development.

The
Director of IBL and the Chairman of the Department of Food Science and
Technology (FST) were sincerely thanked for their support and facilitation in
making the recruitment drive a success.

This
collaboration reflects AWKUM’s ongoing commitment to providing career
opportunities and professional growth for its students through strong industry
linkages.
